regionalClassification.title: Designated regional area postcodes
regionalClassification.notes: Inclusive postcode ranges copied from the official table. This is not the ABS remoteness classification, a visa eligibility decision, or a state nomination assessment.

geographicReference.title: ASGS Edition 4 Postal Areas 2026
geographicReference.notes: POAs approximate geographic postcodes and are not Australia Post address validation. Absent, new or special-purpose postcodes return unknown, never assumed regional. Shared postcodes are withheld pending actual address checks.

privacy: Lookup is entirely local. No external geocoder, map tiles, address collection, analytics or network request is used. The postcode enters the opt-in enquiry snapshot only if the visitor explicitly chooses to attach scoring answers.
